SELECT CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM app.PensieAlimentara 
        WHERE CodSucursala = '[GetOrSession:BranchV]' 
          AND Anul = '[GetOrSession:YearV=0]' 
          AND Luna = '[GetOrSession:MonthV=0]' 
          AND StatusCalculTaxe = 3
    ) THEN 3
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM app.PensieAlimentara 
        WHERE CodSucursala = '[GetOrSession:BranchV]' 
          AND Anul = '[GetOrSession:YearV=0]' 
          AND Luna = '[GetOrSession:MonthV=0]' 
          AND StatusCalculTaxe = 2
    ) THEN 2 
    ELSE 1   
END AS TokenStatusTaxePostale;
